payload.title: Correct address-only loss reporting in reusable legacy lexical report projections
payload.summary: Priority3 historical-report usability. experiments/address_lexical.py _address_payload iterates RepositoryTextLexicalRetrievedRelevantResource wrappers but serializes str(wrapper) for lost resources instead of the wrapped address. A synthetic native BM25 match yields a full nested wrapper representation where an address list is promised. Numeric ranking, frozen scientific judgments and production scoring are not shown wrong.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: a native independently authored retrieved-resource wrapper lost by treatment produces exactly its address in a separately versioned/read-only derived report; recovered/lost identity semantics and numeric metrics are unchanged; historical originals and their hashes stay immutable. Determine whether any current consumer needs correction before changing a retired implementation; document no-action if only frozen reports remain consumed.
payload.uncertainty: Only the reporting primitive was exercised; no old benchmark or ranking treatment was rerun. A derived inspection adapter may be sufficient; do not edit archived results to make an old format appear corrected.
